competitors.title:
Most people are still misunderstanding what @worldlibertyfi is building.

While timelines argue narr
competitors.description:
Most people are still misunderstanding what @worldlibertyfi is building.

While timelines argue narratives…
they’re quietly expanding real infrastructure and liquidity control.

WorldLibertyFi’s stablecoin USD1 is now:

→ Integrated into institutional rails (BitGo Mint)
→ Used as the settlement layer for RWA perps (gold, oil, silver)  

At the same time…

They’re pushing deeper into financial rails:

→ Building a forex + remittance platform (World Swap)
→ Targeting cheaper global money movement  

⸻

But here’s where it gets interesting 👇

The protocol is also experimenting with AI-powered finance:

→ AgentPay SDK lets AI agents
• hold funds
• move money
• enforce policies across chains  

This is where DeFi + AI starts to merge.

⸻

Now the controversial part:

Their own treasury just:

→ Deposited ~3B WLFI
→ Borrowed ~$50M USD1
→ Drained liquidity pools

Result?

• Rates spiked to ~35%
• Liquidity went negative
• Potential liquidation risks increased  

⸻

Most people will see this and panic.

But step back.

This tells you something important:

👉 They control their own liquidity environment

That’s power… but also risk.

⸻

So what’s the full picture?

Bull case:
• USD1 gaining real utility (RWA + institutions)
• Expansion into payments/remittance
• AI + finance integration
• Early-stage infrastructure play

Bear case:
• Political + regulatory pressure
• Centralized treasury influence
• Liquidity risks & potential cascades
• Narrative dependency

⸻

Zoom out.

WorldLibertyFi isn’t trying to win DeFi.

It’s trying to become:

👉 The bridge between TradFi, stablecoins, and programmable money

And those plays don’t move fast…

…but when they do, they dominate.

⸻

Most people will wait for “confirmation.”

By then, the narrative will already be priced in.

Keep it on your radar.

According to a new report from Ch
industry.description:
Chainalysis: Stablecoin Economic Volume Could Reach $719T by 2035

According to a new report from Chainalysis, inflation-adjusted real economic transaction volume of stablecoins could grow from $28 trillion in 2025 to $719 trillion by 2035, with upside potentially approaching $1.5 quadrillion under additional macro catalysts.

The report highlights an estimated $100 trillion global intergenerational wealth transfer beginning in 2028 as a key driver, as millennials and Gen Z show significantly higher adoption of crypto assets. It also projects that stablecoin payment processing volume could reach parity with traditional networks such as Visa between 2031 and 2039.
